ui.intro: Your StarCraft journey starts here. Configure your game directory to get ready.
ui.analyticsHelp: Silently reports visits and online status. Pauses offline and resumes when connectivity returns. Separate from error telemetry.
ui.telemetryHelp: With consent, send redacted errors and stacks linked to an installation ID. No screenshots, native memory dumps or account identity. Disable at any time; requests already sent cannot be recalled.
ui.telemetryState.disabled: Runtime: disabled. No new reports will be sent.
ui.telemetryState.enabled: Runtime: error reporting enabled. This does not confirm server delivery.
ui.telemetryState.failed: Runtime: initialization failed. Configuration or environment is unavailable; try restarting the app.
ui.unavailable: Self-update is unavailable in this environment
ui.desktopOnly: Desktop bridge unavailable. Use these settings in the Electron app.
